program.name: Tempo & Yin
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: Slow strength between core work and yin: supersets one day, straight sets the next.
program.about: Tempo strength with a calm frame around it. One day opens with a core circuit, then slow supersets, then a yin finish for the spine; the other opens with a Pilates series, then slow straight sets, then yin for the hips. Every rep takes its time. Both later levels slow the reps down further.
program.split: Core circuit, slow supersets & yin / Pilates, slow straight sets & yin
